access_boundary: This record represents the mistralai/Mixtral-8x22B-Instruct-v0.1 instruct weight release at Hugging Face commit cc88a6cc19fbd17d9f1c0ee0b0d70a748dce698d (last modified 2025-07-24). Its open-mixtral-8x22b API line retired on March 30, 2025 with migration directed at Mistral Small 4. The Mixtral-8x22B-v0.1 base weights, Mixtral 8x7B, and community quantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated 141B-total, 39B-active checkpoint under a declared Apache-2.0 grant with no use restrictions
Release, retirement, and replacement all dated on first-party docs
tradeoffs: No LICENSE file ships beside the weights, and the card has no release-date or version statement, so the grant rests on card and docs declarations
The managed API is retired, and the very large checkpoint narrows practical self-operation
